candidates.change_summary: Replace the line that sets acc.unlockTime to use block.timestamp unconditionally, removing the user-provided _unlockTime effect so Put always sets unlockTime to now.
Replace the line that sets acc.unlockTime to always use the provided _unlockTime (even if it's in the past), so Put can set unlockTime to an earlier timestamp than block.timestamp.

Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to omit re-locking after the function, leaving locked_ true and preventing subsequent Put calls; this changes behavior observable after Put by affecting reentrancy/blocking semantics.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to remove the initial require so functions can be reentered (no lock check), changing observable behavior by allowing reentrancy during Put.
Remove the reentrancy guard by deleting the lock set and clear in the modifier (so it no longer prevents reentrancy).
Invert the require so the modifier blocks when unlocked and allows only when locked (changing which calls proceed).
Move the balance decrement to occur before the external call so funds are removed prior to sending (prevents some differences in reentrant behavior).
